_comment: Friends who have opted in, on top of the core MAIL_TO list.
Australia's Spam Act needs consent from the PERSON THEMSELVES — a mate
cannot sign someone else up. So only add someone here after they have
personally asked, and record where that request came from. The 'consent'
field is the evidence if anyone ever queries it.
To add: append an entry. To remove: set active to false (keep the record,
so an unsubscribe cannot be quietly undone by a later edit).
source: how they asked — 'subscribe email', 'in person', 'whatsapp', etc.
